title: Filter, Map and Reduce
hints: `Filter` and `Map` are adapters: inside the returned function, `for v := range seq`, then decide what to yield. `Reduce` is a consumer: it just loops, no closure needed.

`Filter`: yield `v` only when `keep(v)` is true. `Map`: yield `f(v)`. In both, `return` as soon as `yield` returns `false`; that `return` also stops `seq`. `Reduce`: `acc := init`, then `acc = f(acc, v)` in a range loop.
